entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After receiving the news of his son..."
entries.dialogueText: After receiving the news of his son's arrest, Uncle Hugo was on his way to talk to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "If he were to openly go against me,..."
entries.dialogueText: If he were to openly go against me, I'd have a big problem with my entire house. I thought about each scenario in my head and tried to devise a plan.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Thoughts were running through my mi..."
entries.dialogueText: Thoughts were running through my mind as I paced back and forth in my chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, there was a knock on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, there was a knock on the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I granted Hugo permission to enter,..."
entries.dialogueText: I granted Hugo permission to enter, and he walked in. He seemed more sad than angry -- something that took me off guard.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: He bowed in front of me, lower and longer than he'd normally go for.

entries.dialogueText: "Grand Vizier. Thank you for coming."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Uncle Hugo. I was expecting you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You can rise, uncle. There is no need for that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

entries.dialogueText: I nodded.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus, my king. May I speak freely?""
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, my king. May I speak freely?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You always have, Hugo. Speak your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You always have, Hugo. Speak your mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know why you're here. Just be ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know why you're here. Just be careful about your choice of words."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you have to.""
entries.dialogueText: "If you have to."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's about my son...""
entries.dialogueText: "It's about my son..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course you do. It's about my so..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course you do. It's about my son..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""About your decision to remove him..."
entries.dialogueText: "About your decision to remove him as the Duke of Iza."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo leaned forward slightly, his h..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo leaned forward slightly, his hands clasped together, choosing his words carefully.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand that he was not popul..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that he was not popular in the city. King Valero himself had reservations about his readiness to become Duke. Yet..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was a decision not made lightly..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a decision not made lightly, Uncle. The entire population was demanding his removal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His actions left me no choice, Unc..."
entries.dialogueText: "His actions left me no choice, Uncle. He was endangering the stability of our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet what?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yet what?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's expression remained unchange..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's expression remained unchanged, but there was a flicker of sadness in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand the weight of the cro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand the weight of the crown and the decisions it demands. But he is my son, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He is my son, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "He is my son, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And I... I was not consulted.""
entries.dialogueText: "And I... I was not consulted."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His demeanor made me feel uncomfort..."
entries.dialogueText: His demeanor made me feel uncomfortable. I couldn't meet his gaze. I had to look away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I value your counsel, Hugo, more t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I value your counsel, Hugo, more than you know. But some decisions must be made swiftly, to protect the realm."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand what it looks like, H..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand what it looks like, Hugo. But Rico failed at his job. I wouldn't do anything to hurt House Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You were not consulted precisely b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were not consulted precisely because of this. He is your son and emotions would have risen just like they're doing right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's done is done. You should le..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's done is done. You should learn to accept it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You are right... I wouldn't questi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are right... I wouldn't question your judgment."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I accepted it already. I wouldn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "I accepted it already. I wouldn't question your judgment."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I have served this family and this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have served this family and this kingdom all my life, Romus. My loyalty has never wavered."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed, and I wouldn't question yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, and I wouldn't question your judgment."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I know... And I wouldn't question..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know... And I wouldn't question your judgment."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But as a father yourself, you must..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as a father yourself, you must understand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do not doubt your loyalty, nor d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not doubt your loyalty, nor do I take your sacrifices for granted. Your son's removal was not a punishment but a necessity. For him, for you, for all of us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your loyalty and service to our fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your loyalty and service to our family and kingdom have never been in question. I am open to discussing how we might address this situation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand your pain, uncle. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your pain, uncle. But you must let it go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Trust me. Him being the Duke of Iz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me. Him being the Duke of Iza was more dangerous to his life and our family's reputation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come now, uncle. Rico lost a job w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come now, uncle. Rico lost a job which he was unsuited for anyway. He'll survive this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I appreciate your willingness to c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your willingness to consider a path to redemption for my son."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I do not question your motives, Ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not question your motives, Romus. But I nonetheless believe I was owed a consultation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""However, the loss of his position..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the loss of his position has... repercussions. For his future and for the name of our family."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed, I will. But I nonetheless..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, I will. But I nonetheless believe I was owed a consultation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes. But I nonetheless believe I w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. But I nonetheless believe I was owed a consultation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And the loss of his position has....."
entries.dialogueText: "And the loss of his position has... repercussions. For his future and for the name of our family."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Some form of compensation could ea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some form of compensation could ease this transition."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The loss of his position has... re..."
entries.dialogueText: "The loss of his position has... repercussions. For his future and for the name of our family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your feelings are justified, Hugo...."
entries.dialogueText: "Your feelings are justified, Hugo. In the haste of the moment, I overlooked the personal ramifications. For that, I offer my regret. But that's all I can offer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What amends do you seek? Tell me.""
entries.dialogueText: "What amends do you seek? Tell me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see. You seek a salve for the wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. You seek a salve for the wound this has caused our lineage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, Uncle. I cannot offer anything..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Uncle. I cannot offer anything. Rico must face the consequences for his actions."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not as a challenge to your authori..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not as a challenge to your authority, but as a balm for our family."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'm just asking for something in r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just asking for something in return. A role, an estate, something to maintain the dignity of my son and provide a path forward for him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo took a deep breath, his postur..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo took a deep breath, his posture relaxing ever so slightly, yet there was an underlying current of disappointment in his voice.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then I shall stand by your decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I shall stand by your decision, as I have always stood by you and your father before you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""My loyalty to the crown and to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "My loyalty to the crown and to you remains unshaken. You are my monarch, and my family."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand you cannot offer him..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand you cannot offer him a title right after revoking it. But please consider offering him a job in the capital."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""How about he works for Duchess Aza..."
entries.dialogueText: "How about he works for Duchess Azaro? As Chief of the Porte Drazon Police Department?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Absolutely not. I am definitely no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely not. I am definitely not going to trust Rico with the security of our capital."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So he can escalate tensions right..."
entries.dialogueText: "So he can escalate tensions right at my doorstep as well? No. I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sure. I can do that. I'll tell Luc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure. I can do that. I'll tell Lucita."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "For the kingdom, and for our family."

Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you, Romus. I am heartened b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Romus. I am heartened by your understanding."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's expression softened slightly..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's expression softened slightly, a sign of relief mixed with the residual weight of the situation.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""My son’s actions notwithstanding,..."
entries.dialogueText: "My son’s actions notwithstanding, I believe in his capacity for growth and redemption. I am committed to guiding him on this path, for the sake of our family and Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He extended his hand to me."
entries.dialogueText: He extended his hand to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I value your fidelity, Hugo. I'm g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I value your fidelity, Hugo. I'm glad we have this mutual understanding."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Very well. I shall return to my du..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. I shall return to my duties now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Hugo exited, I was left to ponde..."
entries.dialogueText: As Hugo exited, I was left to ponder the intricate balance of ruling, where the lines between kinship and kingship blurred.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stood up and prepared for my next..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood up and prepared for my next meeting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo leaned forward slightly, his h..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo leaned forward slightly, his hands clasped together. His voice trembled with emotion when he spoke.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus, how could this have happene..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, how could this have happened? My son, Rico, involved in the Zille bombing? Treason against his own country?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Realizing he was losing the volume..."
entries.dialogueText: Realizing he was losing the volume of his voice, he stopped himself.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Excuse me, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse me, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's okay, Hugo. I understand that..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's okay, Hugo. I understand that it's painful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you are angry. But it had t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you are angry. But it had to be done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I waited for him to recollect himse..."
entries.dialogueText: I waited for him to recollect himself.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I also didn't want to believe it...."
entries.dialogueText: "I also didn't want to believe it. But it's true. I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus, I come before you in the de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, I come before you in the deepest humility."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Right now, my anger is limited to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right now, my anger is limited to Rico."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo shook his head, his grief etch..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo shook his head, his grief etched deep into the lines of his face. I hadn't seen him this sad since my father's funeral.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The actions of my son... I cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "The actions of my son... I cannot fathom what led Rico to such darkness. The bombing, the scandal over Zille's return... It's a stain upon our House."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I stand here, not only as your Gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand here, not only as your Grand Vizier but as a father disgraced, to beg your forgiveness for the turmoil he has wrought."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rico's actions were indeed treache..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rico's actions were indeed treachery against Rizia. But the guilt is his to bear, not yours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a tragedy that one of our own..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a tragedy that one of our own was involved. The repercussions have been severe, and we all must bear a responsibility for letting this take place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You need not ask for forgiveness,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You need not ask for forgiveness, Uncle. Rico is already paying for his own actions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May the Divine forgive you and you..."
entries.dialogueText: "May the Divine forgive you and your son."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "As his father, the onus falls upon me. I failed in guiding him, in instilling the values of our lineage."

entries.dialogueText: "For that, I must ask for your pardon, for my oversight, for any taint his actions have brought upon your reign."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your integrity and loyalty have ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your integrity and loyalty have never been in question, Hugo. The heart of a father cannot always steer the will of a son."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You cannot blame yourself for this..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot blame yourself for this. You couldn't have done anything about it. We must now look to the future."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You are right...""
entries.dialogueText: "You are right..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But... He is still my son, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "But... He is still my son, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand the need for justice..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand the need for justice but is there no room for mercy for him? For a chance at redemption?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He didn't have any mercy when he o..."
entries.dialogueText: "He didn't have any mercy when he orchestrated the bombing that not only took lives but also our land. I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your feelings are justified, Hugo...."
entries.dialogueText: "Your feelings are justified, Hugo. But you are being emotional. Rico is now an enemy of the state. I offer my regret. But that's all I can offer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, Uncle. I cannot offer anything..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Uncle. I cannot offer anything. Rico must face the consequences for his actions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I feel your pain, Uncle. But I don..."
entries.dialogueText: "I feel your pain, Uncle. But I don't know what I can do about it now. I promise I'll try my best to mend our wounds."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I do not ask for exoneration, only..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not ask for exoneration, only that his life be spared."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Let him live, even if in exile or..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let him live, even if in exile or imprisonment and don't send him to Wehlen. God knows what they'll do to him there."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Just let him have a chance to aton..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just let him have a chance to atone, in whatever way remains to him."

entries.dialogueText: He lowered his head, hands still clasped. The plea was evident in his voice and posture.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will consider your request, Hugo.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will consider your request, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course. I will not do anything..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot promise that, Uncle. Wehl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot promise that, Uncle. Wehlen demands justice. There is nothing I can do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If President Smolak demands him to..."
entries.dialogueText: "If President Smolak demands him to be sent in exchange for Zille, I'll have to take it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand...""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But should such a black mark be pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "But should such a black mark be placed on my family, I am not sure I will be able to serve you in the same capacity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo took a deep sigh."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo took a deep sigh.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you, Romus...""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Romus..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I will trust your wisdom.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will trust your wisdom."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I appreciate your willingness to c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your willingness to consider a path to redemption for my son. I am humbled before you."

entries.dialogueText: He bowed.

entries.dialogueText: "All shall be well, uncle."
